description: Java Spring Boot controller class for handling backend API endpoints related to orders, roles, products, and users in an online mall application.

classes.name: OmsController
classes.description: Spring Boot REST controller managing order, role, product, and user endpoints for the online mall backend.

methods.name: orders
methods.description: Handles POST request to fetch filtered orders based on order status form.

methods.name: customerOrder
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve orders for a specific user ID with pagination.

methods.name: roleList
methods.description: Handles GET request to list all roles.

methods.name: addRole
methods.description: Handles POST request to add a new role.

methods.name: updateRole
methods.description: Handles PUT request to update an existing role.

methods.name: productList
methods.description: Handles GET request to list all products.

methods.name: addProduct
methods.description: Handles POST request to add a new product.

methods.name: updateProduct
methods.description: Handles PUT request to update an existing product.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve user details by username.

methods.name: getAllUsers
methods.description: Handles GET request to list all users.
